# Auto-generated by scripts/alp_orchestrate.py -- do not edit.
# Per-core Kconfig fragment for slice `m33_sm` (zephyr).

CONFIG_ALP_SDK=y
CONFIG_LOG=y
CONFIG_PRINTK=y
CONFIG_THREAD_LOCAL_STORAGE=y
CONFIG_LOG_DEFAULT_LEVEL=3

# On-module HW manifest EEPROM -> portable bus 0 (alp-i2c0);
# enables alp_hw_info_read() + the console banner manifest line.
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_HW_INFO_EEPROM_I2C_BUS_ID=0

CONFIG_ALP_SDK_SOM_HW_REV="r1"

# SoM silicon (renesas:rzv2n:n44 via E1M-V2M101)
CONFIG_ALP_SOC_RENESAS_RZV2N_N44=y

# Cross-EVK board facade selector (<alp/board.h>); CONFIG_COMPILER_OPT is single-value (do not also set in prj.conf).
CONFIG_COMPILER_OPT="-DALP_BOARD_E1M_X_EVK"

# SoM-intrinsic chip drivers (from `E1M-V2M101` on_module + helper_firmware)
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_ACT8760=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_CLK_5L35023B=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_DA9292=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_DEEPX_DXM1=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_EEPROM_24C128=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_GD32G553=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_MURATA_LBEE5HY2FY=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_OPTIGA_TRUST_M=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_PI3DBS12212=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_RTL8211FDI=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_RV3028C7=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_TMP112=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_TPS628640=y

# Board-populated chip drivers (from the resolved board definition)
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_BME280=n
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_BMI323=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_BMP581=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_BLOCK_BUTTON_LED=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_CAM_MUX_PI3WVR626=n
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_ICM42670=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_INA236=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_LIS2DW12=n
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_LSM6DSO=n
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_OV5640=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_BLOCK_PDM_MIC=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_SSD1306=n
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_SSD1331=n
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_TAS2563=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_TCAL9538=y

# Project-declared chips (board.yaml `chips:` array)
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_ST7789=y

# Zephyr subsystems required on core `m33_sm` (chip drivers + peripherals)
CONFIG_GPIO=y
CONFIG_I2C=y
CONFIG_SPI=y

# Libraries declared on core `m33_sm`
CONFIG_CMSIS_DSP=y
CONFIG_CMSIS_DSP_BASICMATH=y
CONFIG_CMSIS_DSP_COMPLEXMATH=y
CONFIG_CMSIS_DSP_CONTROLLER=y
CONFIG_CMSIS_DSP_FASTMATH=y
CONFIG_CMSIS_DSP_FILTERING=y
CONFIG_CMSIS_DSP_INTERPOLATION=y
CONFIG_CMSIS_DSP_MATRIX=y
CONFIG_CMSIS_DSP_STATISTICS=y
CONFIG_CMSIS_DSP_SUPPORT=y
CONFIG_CMSIS_DSP_TRANSFORM=y
CONFIG_ALP_CMSIS_DSP_SCALAR=y
CONFIG_ALP_TFLM_REF_KERNELS=y

# §D.lib.loader -- per-library HW-accelerator wiring (auto-emitted).
CONFIG_ALP_TFLM_DRP_AI=y  # tflite_micro / ml_npu_primary
CONFIG_ALP_TFLM_NEON=y  # tflite_micro / simd
CONFIG_ALP_TFLM_DMA_COPY=y  # tflite_micro / dma
CONFIG_ALP_CMSIS_DSP_NEON=y  # cmsis_dsp / simd
CONFIG_ALP_CMSIS_DSP_TMU_CORDIC=y  # cmsis_dsp / cordic
CONFIG_ALP_CMSIS_DSP_TMU_FFT=y  # cmsis_dsp / fft
CONFIG_ALP_CMSIS_DSP_ADC_DMA=y  # cmsis_dsp / dma

# Inference dispatchers (from SoM capabilities -- customer does not pick)
CONFIG_CPP=y
CONFIG_STD_CPP17=y
CONFIG_TENSORFLOW_LITE_MICRO=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_INFERENCE_BACKEND_TFLM=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_INFERENCE_TFLM_KERNEL_REF=y
